responsibility: Declares the small C-linkage interface to GCC’s prefix-translation utility for clients such as front ends and support libraries. It exports update_path for runtime relocation and prefix rewriting of configured paths and set_std_prefix for overriding the base compiled-in prefix, without exposing the internal translation, registry, or canonicalization machinery from prefix.cc.
same_name_distinction: Provides only the public C-linkage declarations for the prefix utility so other GCC components can call update_path and set_std_prefix, without containing the path-translation, environment/registry lookup, or canonicalization implementation found in prefix.cc.
